format: Each seat is [x_cm, y_cm, z_cm, yaw_deg, row, view] in Unreal space (cm, Y flipped from Blender). z is the standing/seat-pan reference height; yaw faces the stage or event floor. view: 0 clear, 1 limited/side view, 2 not sold in the end-stage config (behind the stage). Floor GA 'seats' are standing spots at the configured density.
